name: Kodama Hajime
source:
Though she's serious, Hajime is mostly ignorant to things that would be considered common knowledge in modern society. She greatly treasures her younger sister [url=/c98248]Ichika[/url], and tends to spoil her against her better judgment. Due to attracting others with her mysterious aura, some of the students worship her as the "Living God".

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
